record_type_quote: One subject spent 70 hours learning lists and relearning them after 20 min, 1 hour, 9 hours, 1 day, 2 days, or 31 days.

targets.title: Urmanuskript "Ueber das Gedächtniß"
targets.evidence_quote: The current study was set up to replicate the findings by Ebbinghaus [ 8 , 9 ].
targets.outcome_quote: We believe that we may conclude that our attempt to replicate Ebbinghaus’ classic forgetting was successful.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall successful verdict governs despite differences at 31 days and exploratory curve fitting.

reasoning: New single-participant data re-test the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve. Both original reports explicitly cited as targets are retained as separate publications; the 1913 translation is not a separate original, and Heller et al. supplies procedural guidance and comparison curves rather than the finding selected for re-test.
